required_stages.description: Per (batch, head) program: valid split count nb = ceil(b_seqlen[b] / block_seq) read from b_seqlen on the device.
fp32 log-sum-exp weighted combine over the valid splits (online running-max recurrence in ascending order, or max pass then weighted-sum pass); invalid splits skipped or neutralised.
Single final normalisation numerator / denominator (epsilon optional), rounded to mid_o.dtype and stored into a freshly allocated (batch, heads, head_dim) output; one launch, no global intermediate.

forbidden_substitutions.message: host-side tensor arithmetic performs the combine
attention recomputation is not part of stage 2
extra buffer or clone; only the output allocation is permitted
host readback of b_seqlen; the valid count must be derived on the device

required_evidence.message: per-batch valid split count derived from b_seqlen
running or global max over splits

outputs.aliasing: none; a freshly allocated (batch, heads, head_dim) tensor in mid_o.dtype on every call

timing_boundary.notes: The timed run() contains a host .item() on the CPU block_seq scalar, the output allocation (plus metadata-only view) and one launch. No clone/masking of mid_o_lse, no copies, no state across calls. bytes_expr counts the mid_o read only (small undercount of lse/b_seqlen/output traffic).
